poolAxis.fallback: If no grid cell passes, use the grid cell with greatest finite score (or baseline if none); still run only the two declared pool cells. Deduplicate identical settings.

selection.population: All unique seed-1 inhibition-grid and pool-axis cells passing every primary gate.
selection.score: Minimum A/B half completion over both halves and both delays minus maximum C spillover fraction over both delays.
selection.ties: First in declared order: six inhibition cells, pool baseline, pool best.
selection.controls: All controls are run and saved. Control failures are not used to switch to a runner-up; the selected setting must pass them for GO.
selection.noPassingCell: Report the curves and stop; no additional search.
selection.failedConfirmation: NO-GO; no replacement candidate or further search.

checkpoints.reference: Last-ten cores at that checkpoint. Full-A completion is recall against the contemporaneous A core, not half-cue completion.
checkpoints.isolation: Independent locked clone for each cue; formation state and RNG are untouched.
checkpoints.controls: Recorded for every trained condition before final ablation. Untrained has no training checkpoints. Primary checkpoint memories are saved.

negativeCue.readback: reject at both delays, nearest-core cutoff 0.5

rule.population: All unique seed-1 inhibition-grid and pool-axis cells passing every primary gate.
rule.score: Minimum A/B half completion over both halves and both delays minus maximum C spillover fraction over both delays.
rule.ties: First in declared order: six inhibition cells, pool baseline, pool best.
rule.controls: All controls are run and saved. Control failures are not used to switch to a runner-up; the selected setting must pass them for GO.
rule.noPassingCell: Report the curves and stop; no additional search.
rule.failedConfirmation: NO-GO; no replacement candidate or further search.
